thread:
sara (support): FYI customer reported 404s + duplicate billing after upgrading to @redwood/sdk-js@0.23.1. They say curl works but node client retries and they got charged twice. Sharing repro and logs.

raman (eng-oncall): Can you paste the exact error/logs and minimal repro? Was this a streaming call or fixed-length?

sara (support): Short repro below — non-streaming. Customer code: 
```js
// index.js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/sdk-js');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
async function main(){
  await client.chat.create({ 
    model: 'redwood-1',
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize our Q1 metrics' }],
    sessionId: 'acct-123' // note camelCase used by their frontend
  });
}
main().catch(console.error);
```

sara (support): Node run shows: 
```
Error: 404 Not Found - route /v1/chat/create
    at Request.handleResponse (...stack..)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```
Also repeated retries: 
```
DEBUG: retry attempt 1 for request /v1/chat/create
DEBUG: retry attempt 2 for request /v1/chat/create
```
Customer says curl to /v1/chat/completions works and their prod uses header Authorization: Bearer <key>.

eli (billing): Duplicate billing — do we have logs showing multiple accepted requests? Any idempotency keys?

raman (eng-oncall): Two things stand out: 1) SDK path looks like /v1/chat/create which may have been renamed server-side to /v1/chat/completions (so 404). 2) param name sessionId vs session_id could affect our idempotency logic if we tie keys to body/params. If SDK changed shape, retries might be treated as distinct requests and bill twice.

anna (pm): Customer reported upgrade from 0.22.x -> 0.23.1. Did the SDK rename endpoints or param casing in that release?

raman (eng-oncall): Checking changelog... I see a refactor in 0.23.1 that introduced a thin compatibility shim that accidentally switched the client method name chat.create (deprecated) to emit path /v1/chat/create instead of /v1/chat/completions. Also noticed sessionId was camelCased in the client serializer. Server expects snake_case for idempotency hashing.

sara (support): Repro steps I gave: 1) npm i @redwood/sdk-js@0.23.1 2) run index.js above 3) observe 404 + two billing events in dashboard (billing IDs: bill_01A, bill_01B). Customer attached two charge_ids.

raman (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 
- Ask customer to pin SDK to 0.22.4 (npm i @redwood/sdk-js@0.22.4) — known working.
- Set env var REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=0 or client config { retries: 0 } to stop automatic retries for now.
- Add explicit header 'Idempotency-Key' to their calls (short-term) so retries are deduped on server.

eli (billing): I'll mark the duplicate charges for refund once we confirm both requests reached the charged state. Please DM charge IDs.

raman (eng-oncall): I'll open an urgent bug: SDK 0.23.1 serializer/path mismatch. Will push 0.23.2 to fix path and normalize param casing. Also adding integration test to ensure sdk -> server idempotency hashing stable across releases.

sara (support): Customer is asking for a patch ETA and wants a temporary safe config. I'll pass the pin + retries=0 + idempotency key steps.

deploy-bot: New issue created: RW-ISSUE-4921 "sdk-js: 0.23.1 path/serializer mismatch causes 404 and duplicate billing" assigned to raman (eng-oncall).

raman (eng-oncall): Tentative plan: hotfix branch -> unit + integration tests -> publish 0.23.2 within 2 business days. I'll also add a log-level check to warn when client path != server catalog at runtime.

anna (pm): Please add a short support KB article with the workaround steps and include refund escalation steps. I'll coordinate comms if a wider customer impact is found.

sara (support): Thanks — I'll update the customer and include the pin + retries=0 config and ask for the two charge IDs. :thumbsup:

raman (eng-oncall): For internal follow-up: we should verify changelog, add a guard in release pipeline to run end-to-end against the latest server contract.

sara (support): Closing loop once 0.23.2 is published. If anyone sees other customers with 0.23.1, please ping me and I'll triage.
